entries.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: neutral archival editorial illustration for the Guerrazzi educational materials library. Primary request: a beautiful quiet still life of an OPEN BLANK archival folio with warm ivory cotton paper sheets, two narrow index tabs and a closed linen-bound reference notebook beside it. This is a visual about documentation and reading sources, NOT about any merchandise. Style: tactile cut-paper and delicate intaglio engraving, finely controlled paper grain, credible soft daylight, clean contemporary editorial composition. Palette: warm ivory, muted chestnut brown, a single fine cobalt blue curved thread. Landscape 3:2; compose the folio on the right two-thirds, allow generous calm ivory negative space on the left; avoid repeated flat stacks. Reference image 1 supplies only the illustration craftsmanship; reference image 2 only the quiet smooth wood palette. Keep background ivory, no shop interior. NO tobacco, cigars, pipes, smoke, brand marks, packaging, seals, gold, ornamental luxury styling, writing, letters or labels. No uncanny textures or knots.

entries.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: editorial illustration for practical luggage storage information in central Bologna. Primary request: one simple cobalt-blue wheeled cabin suitcase in a clean two-point three-quarter view, beside a modest ivory travel notebook and a thin cobalt line that curves beneath them. Include one small abstract arc motif suggesting a portico, not an actual building, no location map, no invented route. Style must match the supplied finely stippled cobalt and ivory printed engraving; elegant tactile paper, restrained contours, beautiful broad negative space. Landscape 3:2, suitcase on left third, notebook lower centre, airy warm ivory background. Small terracotta luggage tag without letters, one yellow detail allowed. No logos, no words, no shop interior, no people, no product brand, no luggage claims. This is an illustration, not an evidence photograph. Keep the suitcase recognisable and structurally plausible, exactly two visible wheels, one telescopic handle.

entries.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: clearly illustrative botanical plate, not a scientific specimen photograph. Create a restrained botanical editorial study inspired by Erica arborea, rendered as fine forest-green ink and muted gouache on clean warm ivory cotton paper. Landscape 3:2 with a tall asymmetrical botanical shoot occupying the right two-thirds: slender branches, tiny needle-like leaves in whorls of three to four and small hanging bell-shaped pale flowers. At the lower left, a separate small deliberately SCHEMATIC silhouette of the root-shoot transition shows a modest woody basal swelling connected to the stem and a few roots. This explanatory drawing must have NO invented internal anatomy, cutaways, measurements, identification marks, specimen labels or decorative calligraphy. Generous clean negative space, fine engraved contours, subtle matte tactile grain, a very thin cobalt printer-like rule near the lower edge. Reference 1 is craftsmanship only, reference 2 forest green tone only. No text, stamps, pots, people, shop interior, pipe, cigar or tobacco products. Elegant, airy, non-eerie.

entries.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: quiet educational material-study illustration, NOT a specimen photograph.
